limits: Most photos come from US presidential or government archives; this is not representative of ordinary uploads.
Public internet images may overlap classifier or controller training data; training holdout is unverified.
Breed references are documentary labels, not genetic ancestry.
Pairs can be months or years apart; Buddy includes a growth-related appearance change.
All images and derivatives sharing a leakage_group must stay in one split. Splits are small and not stratified.
No naturally captured blur pair, verified immediate retake, or independently verified mixed-breed ancestry pair is included.
No pair is asserted to produce conflicting classifier results. Disagreement must be observed later without replacing cases to force it.
No bounding-box annotations yet. Images can support manual region selection; crop evaluation requires recorded regions.
The existing evaluate.py handles single-photo manifests; this v2 corpus is not a drop-in manifest for that runner.
